# share.easyaistudy.cn

Public static pages hosted on Cloudflare Pages.

- Live: https://share.easyaistudy.cn/
- Add a folder with `index.html` (ASCII folder names recommended), push to `main`, and it goes live.
- Prefer relative links inside each mini-site so folders stay portable.

Course notes currently also live at https://dreamfox.github.io/notes/ and can be mirrored here later under paths like `/ai-venture/`.
